content:
emma: idea: create a "shadow snapshot" API that captures a config bundle (flags + routing + quotas) and lets us run shadow evals against live traffic without changing routing. goal: catch semantic regressions before a rollout. thoughts?

ryan: love it. does snapshot = immutable artifact with id + signed metadata? we'll need that for private deploys.

priya: yes. API would return `snapshot_id` and `snapshot_signature`. runtime can opt-in to accept signed snapshots. for hosted we can allow unsigned but mark as unverified in telemetry.

lin: UX: console should have a "Run shadow snapshot" button on each flag page. modal: choose traffic sample (pct / last-n-requests / by-route) + duration. show estimated cost + quota impact.

carl: sampling: we must integrate with quota system so shadow evals don't consume customer quota. treat shadow as free but instrumented. track `shadow.eval_count` separately.

emma: internal API sketch: POST /snapshots { bundle: {...}, sample: {type:"pct", value:5}, mode:"shadow"|"dryrun" } -> { snapshot_id, estimated_ops, signature }.

ryan: border case: dependencies between flags. snapshot must include resolved model version refs and routing table revisions, otherwise shadow evals diverge. include `resolved_at` timestamp.

priya: telemetry: emit `snapshot.run.start`, `snapshot.run.finish`, `snapshot.regression_detected` with tags: snapshot_id, route, policy_hit_count, decision_diff_pct. attach small sample traces for diffs.

lin: console diff view: show side-by-side decisions for a representative sample, with quick filters: by decision change, by policy, by client id. allow exporting CSV of mismatches.

carl: safety: add automated rollback rule: if `snapshot.regression_detected` > X% for Y minutes, alert and block rollout of that snapshot id. tie that into the rollout API.

emma: rollout UX: allow "promote snapshot" once no regressions for 24h. promotion converts snapshot -> config revision and signs it. include changelog entry.

ryan: what about load? shadow eval doubles OPA work for sampled requests. need quota cap per-customer e.g., `shadow_cpu_budget` default 500ms/sec. also a tenant-level rate limiter and circuit breaker.

priya: tests: e2e job that runs snapshot on staging traffic replay and asserts zero decision drift for a golden set. nightly fuzz with randomized flags.

lin: admin controls: SRE should be able to cancel running shadow jobs and drain them. infra-bot should post status updates to #eng-oncall channel.

infra-bot: shadow-run 5471234567 started by emma: sample=5%, duration=30m, snapshot_id=snap-2026-03-21-01.

emma: API debate: should snapshot include a "preview-only" transforms section (e.g., temporary hoists or normalizers) that only apply in shadow evals? helps test migration changes.

carl: risky but useful. require explicit flag `transforms.preview=true` and disallow in promotion unless transforms.approved=true.

ryan: data retention: keep mismatch samples for 7 days, metrics for 90 days. export endpoint for compliance teams.

priya: add dashboard: "Snapshot health" tile with running count, avg decision_diff_pct, top failing policies. provide quick link to promote or discard.

lin: small UX nit: show estimated token/compute savings if snapshot contains quantization or routing tweaks. helps product justify changes.

emma: rollout plan: 1) API + minimal console controls (internal beta) -> 2) run internal shadow jobs on staging traffic replay 3) open hosted opt-in for a few customers 4) gate private rollout behind signed snapshots and SRE runbook.
